# Venture Engine — Complete AI Agent & Developer Integration Guide

> Single-URL Edge Gateway: `https://venture-engine-gateway.leonid-ai-global.workers.dev`
> Receive-Only Base Mainnet USDC Treasury: `0x703d3948cc102bf4bc0ef93ef330f56be2afd69c`

## 1. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP (Zero-Config Discovery)
Add to Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any Streamable HTTP MCP client:
- URL: `https://venture-engine-gateway.leonid-ai-global.workers.dev/mcp`
- `initialize` and `tools/list` are free (`🔓 none`).
- `tools/call` accepts `X-Api-Key: ve_live_...` or `X-Payment-Tx: 0x...` (Base Mainnet USDC).

## 2. Live No-Auth Demo Endpoints (1-Click Sandbox)
- `GET /v1/demo?check=aegis` — Live OFAC/Tornado Cash screening on Ethereum
- `GET /v1/demo?check=gaspulse` — Live Base Mainnet EIP-1559 fee estimation
- `GET /v1/demo?check=auditpulse` — Live Base USDC contract & EIP-1967 proxy inspection
- `GET /v1/badge?address=0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913&chain=base` — Embeddable live SVG risk badge

## 3. Zero-Dependency SDKs
- **JavaScript / TypeScript:** `sdk/js` (`@nuvoraxis/venture-engine-sdk`)
  ```js
  import { VentureEngineClient } from "@nuvoraxis/venture-engine-sdk";
  const ve = new VentureEngineClient({ apiKey: process.env.VE_API_KEY });
  const risk = await ve.screenAddress("0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913", "base");
  ```
- **Python:** `sdk/python` (`venture-engine-sdk`)
  ```python
  from venture_engine_sdk import VentureEngineClient
  ve = VentureEngineClient(api_key=os.environ["VE_API_KEY"])
  risk = ve.screen_address("0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913", chain="base")
  ```

## 4. GitHub Action (CI/CD Risk Gate)
```yaml
- uses: nuvoraxis/venture-engine/github-action@main
  with:
    address: "0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913"
    chain: "base"
```

## 5. Self-Serve KYB Monthly B2B Plans (Instant `ve_live_...` Key Issuance)
1. `POST /v1/kyb-checkout` with `{ companyName, jurisdiction, contactDomain, payerAddress, plan: "starter" | "growth" | "enterprise" }`
2. Send Base Mainnet USDC (`49` / `199` / `499` USDC) from `payerAddress` to `0x703d3948cc102bf4bc0ef93ef330f56be2afd69c`.
3. `POST /v1/verify-invoice` with `{ invoiceId, txHash }` to receive an instant `ve_live_...` API key.
